title: Darth Tyranus
subtitle: Servant of Sidious
text:
Shielded (When you play this unit, give a Shield token to him.)
While the Force is with you, this unit gains Ambush. (When you play this unit, he may attack an enemy unit.)
rules: Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as "When Played" abilities. If there is no enemy unit that can be attacked, the unit does not ready.
